o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish جهنم (cehennem), from Arabic جَهَنَّم (jahannam).

From Proto-Turkic *yol-. Cognate with Chuvash ҫӑл (śăl), Turkish yolmak, Uyghur يۇلماق (yulmaq), Yakut сулуй (suluy).
Unrelated to Azerbaijani yol (“road”), which is derived from *yōl.
From Classical Persian نرگس (nargis), from Middle Persian [Book Pahlavi needed] (nlgs /⁠nargis⁠/), from Ancient Greek νάρκισσος (nárkissos).
Borrowed from Russian нанотехноло́гия (nanotexnológija). By surface analysis, nano- + texnologiya.
